summary: SiteDocument represents a data model for documents associated with a site, encapsulating document and site identifiers.
purpose: To structure and store site-related document records, facilitating data operations, retrieval, and relationship mapping between sites and their documents.
system_behavior: Provides a model for site documents with integer ID and SiteID properties.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is a web page/control for staff administrators, showing welcome content, last login info, and facilitating filtered viewing and searching of staff employment applications.
purpose: To provide a welcome interface for staff admins, summarizing staff activity and enabling application data filtering and search based on sites, disciplines, and date ranges.

fields.name: LastLogin
fields.description: Last login information displayed to staff

workflows.name: Employment Application Search
steps: StaffAdmin selects site, discipline, and date range filters
System applies required field/format validations on dates
StaffAdmin triggers search (RefreshData) via a button
System binds filtered applications to the grid
Applications display with status, withdrawn date, and contact details

business_rules: Start date must be before end date
Withdrawn applications can be optionally included
conditions: Display withdrawn status/withdrawn date only if application is withdrawn
system_behavior: Displays welcome and last login information
Populates filtering dropdowns based on session and agency context
Performs client-side and server-side date validation
Refreshes grid data on filter or button actions

summary: ServiceCode is a data model used for categorizing and describing services via codes, names, notes, and sort orders, supporting localization and search/filtering for course/timetable contexts.
purpose: To provide structured coding for services within the system, including support for localization and filtering within course and timetable workflows.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier of the service code

fields.name: CodeCategoryID
fields.description: Category reference for grouping service codes

workflows.name: Service Code Retrieval
steps: ServiceCodeListAll: retrieves all service codes for session
ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID: retrieves service codes available for a course
ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID: retrieves service codes available for a timetable

business_rules: Localized fields are used if session indicates use of alt language
conditions: Localization of service code name and notes based on session field
system_behavior: Service codes are constructed dynamically from database queries
Can be filtered by course or timetable context
dependencies: Database procedures for service code retrieval

summary: SiteProfileHistory records snapshots of actions performed on site profiles, including user, agency, and field details, for audit and historical purposes.
purpose: To track changes and actions performed on site profiles, including user context, agency, field changes, and localized information for historical/audit reporting.

fields.name: ByUserSysAdmin
fields.description: Indicates if system administrator made change

workflows.name: Site Profile History Recording
steps: System records change in SiteProfileHistory with user, agency, and field details
History is retrievable and can be filtered by site and agency

business_rules: Localized fields are used if session indicates alt language
calculations: ActionDateFormatted: converts ActionDate to short format
conditions: TooltipDetails formatting depends on user admin status and context
system_behavior: Enables audit/history lookup for site profile edits
